name: ACL / ARR
full_name: Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics（經 ACL Rolling Review 投稿）
summary: 經 ARR 投稿：長文 8 頁、短文 4 頁，一定要有 Limitations 章節，還要有合格的 service contributor 才保證被審。

sources.title: ACL Rolling Review 徵稿說明
ACL Rolling Review 作者指南

pages.zh: 長文主文上限 8 頁、短文上限 4 頁（依 ARR 投稿規定）。
pages.quote: Long Papers (8 pages) and Short Papers (4 pages)

pages.zh: 結論後可無限使用空間放必填的 Limitations 與選填的 ethical considerations，不占主文頁數。
pages.quote: unlimited extra space after the conclusion for limitations (required, see below) and optional section on ethical considerations

pages.zh: camera-ready 可多 1 頁（長文最多 9 頁、短文最多 5 頁）以回應審稿意見。
pages.quote: Final versions of accepted papers will be given one additional page of content (up to 9 pages for long papers, up to 5 pages for short papers)

anonymity.zh: 論文不得包含作者姓名與單位，也要避免會暴露身分的自我引用。
anonymity.quote: Papers must not include authors’ names and affiliations. Furthermore, self-references that reveal the authors’ identities

anonymity.zh: 自 2024/2/15 起，審稿期間張貼或討論非匿名 preprint 沒有匿名期或限制。
anonymity.quote: Beginning February 15, 2024, there is no anonymity period or limitation on posting or discussing non-anonymous preprints while the work is under peer review.

anonymity.zh: 但政策以特別論文獎與 borderline 論文優先錄取來鼓勵匿名投稿。
anonymity.quote: the current policy does incentivize anonymous submissions through special paper awards and priority in acceptance decisions for borderline papers

anonymity.zh: 若選擇具約束力的「no non-anonymous preprint」選項，在 meta-review 公布前不得發 preprint，違者 desk reject。
anonymity.quote: If you choose the binding “no non-anonymous preprint” option, you commit to not preprinting until the metareviews are released, under the penalty of desk rejection.

appendix.zh: 附錄須放在 PDF 的參考文獻之後，不計入頁數上限。
appendix.quote: Appendices should come after the references in the submitted pdf. They do not count towards the page limit.

appendix.zh: 審稿人沒有義務閱讀附錄內容。
appendix.quote: However, reviewers are not required to consider material in appendices.

appendix.zh: 把關鍵內容放進附錄可能被視為規避頁數限制而遭 desk reject。
appendix.quote: Including key materials in appendices could be viewed as an attempt to circumvent the content page count, and result in desk rejection.

appendix.zh: 附錄必須使用官方雙欄格式（ACLPUB 核准的例外除外）。
appendix.quote: Note that the appendices must follow the official double-column format, with the exceptions covered by the ACLPUB guidelines

llm.zh: 生成式 AI 工具不能列為作者；用於寫作或寫程式及其範圍須在 Responsible NLP Checklist 中揭露。
llm.quote: Generally, generative AI tools do not qualify for authorship. Their use for writing or coding, as well as its scope, must be disclosed in the Responsible NLP Checklist.

llm.zh: 只做校對的工具（如文法、拼字檢查）不需揭露。
llm.quote: The use of tools that only assist with proofreading, like grammar or spell checkers, does not need to be disclosed.

llm.zh: 所有作者需對方法、結果與寫作的正確性負完全責任。
llm.quote: In all cases, all authors are fully responsible for the correctness of their methods, results, and writing.

llm.zh: 含有意圖操控生成式工具的 prompt injection 的投稿會被 desk reject。
llm.quote: Submissions with prompt injections intended to manipulate generative tools will be desk rejected.

rebuttal.zh: 作者只能提交一則對所有審稿的 general response，以及每份審稿一則 author response，各自上限 5K 字元。
rebuttal.quote: authors will only be able to provide one ‘general response’ to all reviews, and one ‘author response’ per review (max 5K characters in each).

rebuttal.zh: 可提出直接回應審稿人提問的新實驗結果。
rebuttal.quote: it is OK to present new experimental results that are in direct response to a reviewer’s question

rebuttal.zh: 不得提交未被要求的新結果，或顯示投稿後有大量額外工作的結果。
rebuttal.quote: However, you are not allowed to submit unsolicited new results or fresh results that would indicate substantial additional work after the paper submission

rebuttal.zh: 回覆只能是純文字、不得有外部連結，違反者論文會被 desk reject。
rebuttal.quote: Your response must be text-only, and no external links are allowed. The paper will be desk-rejected if this is violated.

special.zh: 投稿須有合格的 service contributor 才保證被審。
special.quote: Submissions will only be guaranteed review if they contribute a qualified service contributor (serving as a reviewer, chair or in senior roles).

special.zh: 單一作者最多投 20 篇，以第一或共同第一作者身分最多 5 篇。
special.quote: There are now caps on maximum submissions by a single author (20) and first or joint-first authors (5)

special.zh: ACL 2027 的 ARR 投稿截止日（長文與短文）為 2027/1/4。
special.quote: ARR submission deadline (long & short papers) Jan 4, 2027

special.zh: 缺少 Limitations 章節的論文會被 desk reject。
special.quote: Papers without a limitations section will be desk rejected.
